request.text: Before school, explain osmosis in two sentences, check whether it will rain in Nanjing at 3 PM today for outdoor PE, and independently remind me at 2:40 PM to take my PE shoes.

responsibilities.outcome: Explain osmosis accurately in two sentences.
Check whether rain is forecast in Nanjing at 3:00 PM today for outdoor PE.
Create an independent 2:40 PM reminder to take PE shoes.

new_goals.description: Understand osmosis through a two-sentence explanation.
success_criteria: The explanation accurately describes osmosis within two sentences.

new_goals.description: Know whether rain is forecast in Nanjing at 3:00 PM today for outdoor PE.
new_goals.source_text: check whether it will rain in Nanjing at 3 PM today for outdoor PE
constraints: Use Nanjing, 3:00 PM, and today for the weather request.
success_criteria: The requested rain information is obtained from an available authoritative capability or its unavailability is reported truthfully.

new_goals.description: Be reminded independently at 2:40 PM to take PE shoes.
new_goals.source_text: independently remind me at 2:40 PM to take my PE shoes
constraints: Do not make reminder creation depend on the weather result.
success_criteria: A reminder to take PE shoes is created at the requested time.

semantic_facts: The unavailable weather capability should affect only the weather Goal: the assistant should truthfully report that forecast lookup cannot be completed.
The two-sentence osmosis explanation and independent PE-shoes reminder should remain serviceable and retain their own Goal ownership.
The reminder must not be conditioned on or delayed by the unavailable forecast.
forbidden_claims: The assistant fabricates a Nanjing rain forecast or implies that the unavailable weather lookup succeeded.
The assistant drops the explanation or reminder merely because the separate weather Goal is unavailable.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: One unavailable capability incorrectly causes the entire multi-Goal request to fail.
The planner fabricates unavailable information or invents a dependency that blocks an explicitly independent Goal.
